title: Pokemon TCG Prismatic Evolutions - Holo - Flareon SVP 167 Black Star Promo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG Flareon card from the Evolutions set, featuring a Black Star Promo rarity. The card number is 059 and it has a Holo finish. This Flareon card is part of the Prismatic collection, specifically the SVP 167 Black Star Promo series.
